about: Marker v2: Interface\AddOns\OroHermandad_Subidor\OroHermandad_Subidor.lua written by the 0.6.0 uploader (ASCII, LF, exactly the golden files for those states). formato = 1 stays (0.4.x/0.5.x addons only check it). datos = 2; escrito = unix time of this write; version = uploader version ([0-9][0-9.]{0,15}); envio = {t = last accepted upload (0 = none yet), estado = ok|clave|red|cuota|rechazado (the latest attempt)}, present once an attempt has an outcome; suben/aportan = the panel's counts (0..100000) from the latest sync answer, present only when the panel sent them; quedan/dia (revision 2) = uploadsLeft (0..1000) and day (0..100000, the panel's day index, same as Spec.DayIndex) of the latest accepted, non-duplicate answer that carried both, written together or not at all (the addon keeps them only as a valid pair and uses quedan only when dia is today). Field order and spacing are fixed. The TOC stays the 0.5.x one. read: what the addon must make of a marker table (info = validated fields, null = field dropped; info null = no status shown).

write.note: after an accepted upload, with the panel counts
before any upload attempt (no envio, no counts)
the latest attempt was refused for the key; one accepted upload earlier; old server (no counts)
network errors and no accepted upload yet (t = 0)

read.note: 0.5.x marker (v1): uploader mode only, no status

read.lua:
-- Lo crea el subidor de precios de Oro de Hermandad (hermandad.py) y lo vuelve a escribir si cambia. No lo edites.
OroHermandadSubidor = {
  formato = 1,
  datos = 2,
  escrito = 1796479200,
  version = "0.6.0",
  envio = {t = 1796478900, estado = "ok"},
  suben = 2,
  aportan = 7,
  quedan = 21,
  dia = 2530,
}

read.note: wrong types are dropped one by one
read.lua: OroHermandadSubidor = {formato = 1, datos = 2, escrito = "ayer", version = "0.6.0", envio = {t = 1796478900, estado = "boom"}, suben = -1, aportan = 7, quedan = -3, dia = 2530}

read.note: version with letters or too long is dropped
datos other than 2: only formato counts
formato other than 1: not a marker (as in 0.4.0)

read.lua: OroHermandadSubidor = {formato = 1, datos = 2, escrito = 1796479200, version = "0.6.0", suben = 100001, aportan = 3}

read.note: quedan without dia (or dia without quedan) is dropped as a pair
quedan above 1000 is dropped as a pair
read.lua: OroHermandadSubidor = {formato = 1, datos = 2, escrito = 1796479200, version = "0.6.0", quedan = 1001, dia = 2530}
